layer1.name: Plausible Analytics
layer1.one_liner: A lightweight, privacy-friendly alternative to Google Analytics.
layer1.description: A single-page analytics dashboard with no cookies and no personal data collection, sold as a subscription. Competing directly against a free incumbent with near-total market share.
layer1.outcome_note: Bootstrapped past $1M ARR and publicly reported around $3.1M ARR by late 2024. The founders published their own milestone write-ups at $500k and $1M.
